Help.General:
ModernNoCupboardDecay prevents decay for entities within Tool Cupboard radius and shows wipe info.
Basic commands:
  /mncd               - Show plugin status.
  /mncdhelp [topic]   - Show help. Topics: basic, ui, set, debug, preview, wipe.
  /mncdpreview        - Draw TC protection rings (hologram).
  /mncddebug          - Toggle your personal protection status overlay.
Admin commands:
  /mncdset            - Live config (radius, auth, wipe mode).
  /mncdui, /mncduiadd - Move the wipe UI panel.
  /mncdresetui        - Reset the wipe UI position.
Use '/mncdhelp <topic>' for details. Example: /mncdhelp preview
Help.UnknownTopic: [MNCD] Unknown help topic '{0}'. Valid topics: basic, ui, set, debug, preview, wipe.
Help.Topic.basic:
MNCD basics:
• All entities within the configured radius of a Tool Cupboard are protected from decay.
• Optional CheckAuth: only entities owned by a TC authed player (or their team) are protected.
• TeamAwareProtection: when enabled, TC owner's Rust team and authed teammates are also covered.
• The TC upkeep 'time left' becomes 'time until wipe' in the MNCD UI.
Useful commands:
  /mncd           - Show current radius, wipe mode, and status.
  /mncddebug      - See if you are currently inside a protected bubble.
Help.Topic.ui:
UI positioning:
  /mncdui <minX> <minY> <maxX> <maxY>
    • Sets the TC wipe UI panel anchors in normalized screen coords (0..1).
    • Example: /mncdui 0.70 0.27 0.95 0.49
  /mncduiadd <dx> <dy>
    • Nudges the UI panel by a small offset.
    • Example: /mncduiadd -0.02 0.10 moves it 2% left, 10% up.
  /mncdresetui
    • Resets the UI to the default top-center position.
Notes:
  • Requires admin or 'modernnocupboarddecay.admin' permission.
  • After changing UI, reopen the TC to refresh the panel.
Help.Topic.set:
Live configuration: /mncdset and mncd.set

Chat (admin):
  /mncdset <option> <value>
Console/RCON:
  mncd.set <option> <value>

Options:
  checkauth <true|false>
    • true  => only entities owned by TC-authed players (and optional teams) are protected.
    • false => anything near a TC is protected.
  teamaware <true|false>
    • When checkauth is true, also protect Rust teammates of TC owner/authed.
  radius <meters>
    • Sets TC protection radius. Example: /mncdset radius 30
  autodetect <true|false>
    • true  => detect wipe schedule from server.tags (weekly, monthly, 5d, etc.).
    • false => use WipeModeOverride.
  wipemode <Manual|Weekly|BiWeekly|Monthly|Nd>
    • Example: /mncdset wipemode 5d (for 5-day wipes).
  wipestartnow
    • Resets wipe start to now. Use if you change wipe schedule mid-wipe.
Help.Topic.debug:
Debug overlay: /mncddebug and mncd.debug

  /mncddebug
    • Toggles a small text panel at the top of your screen:
      'MNCD: Protected'    => you are inside a protected TC radius.
      'MNCD: Not Protected' => you are outside MNCD protection.
  mncd.debug (console)
    • Same as /mncddebug, but from the F1 console for that player.

Notes:
  • Requires admin or 'modernnocupboarddecay.debug' permission.
  • Updates every 0.5 seconds while enabled.
  • Automatically stops and cleans up when you disconnect.
Help.Topic.preview:
TC preview rings: /mncdpreview and mncd.preview

  /mncdpreview
    • Draws 'hologram' spheres around all Tool Cupboards.
    • Uses the configured EntityRadius (optionally multiplied by PreviewRingRadiusMultiplier).
    • Only you see the rings; they are client-side ddraw.

  mncd.preview (console)
    • Same effect, invoked from the F1 console.

Config:
  PreviewRequiresPermission
    • false (default) => everyone can use /mncdpreview.
    • true            => requires 'modernnocupboarddecay.preview' perm or admin.
  PreviewRingDuration
    • How long rings are visible (seconds).
  PreviewRingRadiusMultiplier
    • Multiplies EntityRadius for the visual ring only.
Help.Topic.wipe:
Wipe modes and wipe timer:

Detection:
  • AutoDetectWipeFromTags = true:
    - Reads ConVar.Server.tags for keywords: weekly, biweekly, monthly.
    - Also supports patterns like '5d', '5day', '5days' for custom N-day wipes.
  • AutoDetectWipeFromTags = false:
    - Uses WipeModeOverride from config or /mncdset wipemode.

Supported modes:
  Manual      => no automatic wipe end time.
  Weekly      => 7-day wipes.
  BiWeekly    => 14-day wipes.
  Monthly     => 30-day wipes (fixed length).
  Nd (Custom) => e.g. '5d' => 5-day wipes.

Wipe start:
  • OnNewSave (map/wipe) automatically sets WipeStartUnixTime.
  • /mncdset wipestartnow can manually reset the wipe start.

TC UI:
  • When you open a TC, MNCD shows 'Wipe: <mode> – <time remaining>'.
  • If mode is Manual or time cannot be computed, it shows N/A instead.
